description: Marker id allocation shared by every engine marker setter. Each case runs its steps in order on one fresh engine. A step replaces the whole marker set with `set`; `ids` are the ids the setter returns, in the order given; `stored` are the stored ids in timeline order. A step with `refused: true` must be refused as an out-of-domain argument and leave the stored set and the counter as they were.

cases.name: a higher explicit id moves the counter past it
an id-less entry skips an id a later entry carries
an id is not reused after its marker is removed
a duplicate explicit id is refused and changes nothing
